name: Analyze Device, Greater
body:
School clockwork (divination); Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hr.
Components V, S, F (a complete set of clockworker’s tools)

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets one touched object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You discover all mechanical and magical properties, mechanisms, and functions of a single construct, clockwork device, mechanical trap, or magic item, including how to activate or deactivate those functions, if appropriate, and how many charges are left, if any.
